Program_Name: Empowering the Heliopolis community through a holistic health initiative designed to reduce obesity and foster sustainable wellness by 2026.

By 2027, the SEKEM community aims to adopt and implement the five leading recommended policies to enhance physical activity, serving as a pioneering model for community health and active environments.

Accelerating the implementation of the HEARTS technical package for hypertension prevention and care within the SEKEM community, aiming to increase the number of individuals receiving regular care by 50% by the end of 2027.
